_about: A frozen sample of real OSV.dev records (affected package, ranges, and part of the enumerated versions), used by shared/versions-recall.test.ts. Built on 2026-11-03 from the OSV.dev all.zip dumps of the eight ecosystems.
_attribution: Data from OSV.dev: GitHub Advisory Database (CC-BY-4.0), PyPI Advisory Database (CC-BY-4.0), Go Vulnerability Database (CC-BY-4.0), RustSec Advisory Database (CC0-1.0) and Drupal security advisories (MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 Ackama). Changed: only the advisory ID, package name, version ranges and a sample of the listed versions are kept.
